{
  "_doc": [
      "Pilot contracts catalog, read by ContractManager. Full format reference: header of scripts/systems/ContractManager.gd.",
      "A template = what to count (count.event + count.where, optional count.forbid), how many (target), the reward, the text.",
      "Values written \"{param}\" are replaced by the contract's param when it is generated; the generated contract is saved",
      "self-contained, so removing a template later never breaks a contract a player already has."
  ],
  "version": 1,
  "slots": 3,
  "templates": [
    {"id":"kill_fighter","group":"kill","text":"contracts.desc.kill_type","args":{"enemy":"@contracts.enemy_plural.fighter"},"count":{"event":"kill","where":{"type":"fighter"}},"target":60,"reward":{"coins":500,"xp":80}},
    {"id":"kill_bomber","group":"kill","text":"contracts.desc.kill_type","args":{"enemy":"@contracts.enemy_plural.bomber"},"count":{"event":"kill","where":{"type":"bomber"}},"target":25,"reward":{"coins":500,"xp":80}},
    {"id":"kill_turret","group":"kill","text":"contracts.desc.kill_type","args":{"enemy":"@contracts.enemy_plural.turret"},"count":{"event":"kill","where":{"type":"turret"}},"target":20,"reward":{"coins":500,"xp":80}},
    {"id":"kill_elite","group":"kill","text":"contracts.desc.kill_type","args":{"enemy":"@contracts.enemy_plural.elite"},"count":{"event":"kill","where":{"type":"elite"}},"target":30,"reward":{"coins":500,"xp":80}},
    {"id":"boss_clean","group":"boss","text":"contracts.desc.boss_clean","param":{"pick":[5,{"value":10,"best_wave":5},{"value":15,"best_wave":10},{"value":20,"best_wave":15}]},"count":{"event":"wave_completed","where":{"is_boss":true,"wave":"{param}"},"forbid":[{"event":"bomb","scope":"wave"}]},"target":1,"reward":{"coins":{"base":300,"per_param":40},"xp":{"base":100,"per_param":4}}},
    {"id":"reach_wave","group":"reach","text":"contracts.desc.reach_wave","param":{"best_wave_plus":[1,3],"min":4,"max":20},"count":{"event":"wave_started","where":{"wave":{">=":"{param}"}}},"target":1,"reward":{"coins":{"base":250,"per_param":25},"xp":{"base":60,"per_param":4}}},
    {"id":"no_miss","group":"clean_waves","text":"contracts.desc.no_miss","count":{"event":"wave_completed","forbid":[{"event":"player_hit","scope":"wave"}]},"target":4,"reward":{"coins":600,"xp":100}},
    {"id":"graze","group":"graze","text":"contracts.desc.graze","count":{"event":"graze"},"target":120,"reward":{"coins":450,"xp":80}},
    {"id":"chain","group":"chain","text":"contracts.desc.chain","param":{"pick":[25,40]},"count":{"event":"chain","where":{"chain":{">=":"{param}"}}},"target":1,"reward":{"coins":{"base":400,"per_param":5},"xp":80}},
    {"id":"kill_drone","group":"kill","text":"contracts.desc.kill_type","args":{"enemy":"@contracts.enemy_plural.drone"},"count":{"event":"kill","where":{"type":"drone"}},"target":60,"reward":{"coins":450,"xp":70}},
    {"id":"kill_lancer","group":"variant","text":"contracts.desc.kill_type","args":{"enemy":"@contracts.enemy_plural.lancer"},"count":{"event":"kill","where":{"variant":"lancer"}},"target":12,"reward":{"coins":550,"xp":90}},
    {"id":"kill_miner","group":"variant","text":"contracts.desc.kill_type","args":{"enemy":"@contracts.enemy_plural.miner"},"count":{"event":"kill","where":{"variant":"miner"}},"target":10,"reward":{"coins":550,"xp":90},"requires":{"best_wave":6}},
    {"id":"kill_phantom","group":"variant","text":"contracts.desc.kill_type","args":{"enemy":"@contracts.enemy_plural.phantom"},"count":{"event":"kill","where":{"variant":"phantom"}},"target":12,"reward":{"coins":550,"xp":90},"requires":{"best_wave":11}},
    {"id":"kill_seeker","group":"variant","text":"contracts.desc.kill_type","args":{"enemy":"@contracts.enemy_plural.seeker"},"count":{"event":"kill","where":{"variant":"seeker"}},"target":12,"reward":{"coins":550,"xp":90},"requires":{"best_wave":16}},
    {"id":"run_kills","group":"kill","text":"contracts.desc.run_kills","reset":"run","count":{"event":"kill"},"target":120,"reward":{"coins":600,"xp":100}},
    {"id":"boss_nohit","group":"boss","text":"contracts.desc.boss_nohit","param":{"pick":[5,{"value":10,"best_wave":5},{"value":15,"best_wave":10},{"value":20,"best_wave":15}]},"count":{"event":"wave_completed","where":{"is_boss":true,"wave":"{param}"},"forbid":[{"event":"player_hit","scope":"wave"}]},"target":1,"reward":{"coins":{"base":400,"per_param":50},"xp":{"base":120,"per_param":4}}},
    {"id":"reach_nobomb","group":"reach","text":"contracts.desc.reach_nobomb","param":{"best_wave_plus":[-3,-1],"min":4,"max":20},"count":{"event":"wave_started","where":{"wave":{">=":"{param}"}},"forbid":[{"event":"bomb","scope":"run"}]},"target":1,"reward":{"coins":{"base":300,"per_param":25},"xp":{"base":70,"per_param":4}}},
    {"id":"no_overheat","group":"clean_waves","text":"contracts.desc.no_overheat","count":{"event":"wave_completed","forbid":[{"event":"overheat","scope":"wave"}]},"target":5,"reward":{"coins":450,"xp":80}},
    {"id":"run_grazes","group":"graze","text":"contracts.desc.run_grazes","reset":"run","count":{"event":"graze"},"target":50,"reward":{"coins":500,"xp":90}},
    {"id":"special_use","group":"special","text":"contracts.desc.special_use","count":{"event":"ability"},"target":15,"reward":{"coins":450,"xp":80}},
    {"id":"special_kills","group":"special","text":"contracts.desc.special_kills","count":{"event":"kill","where":{"source":"special"}},"target":40,"reward":{"coins":550,"xp":90}},
    {"id":"dash_dodge","group":"maneuver","text":"contracts.desc.dash_dodge","count":{"event":"dash_dodge"},"target":15,"reward":{"coins":500,"xp":80}},
    {"id":"overdrive","group":"maneuver","text":"contracts.desc.overdrive","count":{"event":"overdrive"},"target":5,"reward":{"coins":500,"xp":80}},
    {"id":"stars","group":"pickups","text":"contracts.desc.stars","count":{"event":"pickup","where":{"type":"medal"}},"target":20,"reward":{"coins":500,"xp":80}},
    {"id":"powerups","group":"pickups","text":"contracts.desc.powerups","count":{"event":"pickup","where":{"type":{"in":["health","bomb","overdrive","shield","coolant"]}}},"target":10,"reward":{"coins":450,"xp":80}},
    {"id":"reach_cycle","group":"cycle","text":"contracts.desc.reach_cycle","param":{"pick":[{"value":2,"best_wave":15},{"value":3,"highest_cycle":2}]},"count":{"event":"wave_started","where":{"cycle":{">=":"{param}"},"start_cycle":{"<":"{param}"}}},"target":1,"reward":{"coins":{"base":400,"per_param":400},"xp":{"base":100,"per_param":50}}},
    {"id":"boss_cycle","group":"cycle","text":"contracts.desc.boss_cycle","param":{"pick":[{"value":2,"highest_cycle":2},{"value":3,"highest_cycle":3}]},"count":{"event":"wave_completed","where":{"is_boss":true,"cycle":{">=":"{param}"}}},"target":1,"reward":{"coins":{"base":300,"per_param":300},"xp":{"base":100,"per_param":30}}},
    {"id":"ellen_frozen","group":"pilot","pilot":[4],"text":"contracts.desc.frozen_kills","count":{"event":"kill","where":{"was_frozen":true}},"target":40,"reward":{"coins":600,"xp":120}}
  ]
}
